An SPT is issued per transaction, bound to the seller's profile, carries a currency, a maximum amount and an expiry, and can be revoked.
Regulation E defines an unauthorized transfer as one initiated by a person without actual authority and from which the consumer receives no benefit.
Its official comment keeps a consumer liable for transfers by someone they authorized until they notify the institution
